leadText:
----
(Japanese: Countdown Pokémon Day) is a Pokémon manga written by Kazumori Matsumura and illustrated by Yaso Hanamura. It was published daily on Poké Times from February 20 to 27, 2025, in celebration of Pokémon Day 2025.
